device.description: 10-bit 1.25 MSPS 8-channel serial SAR ADC with external MUX output (MO/AIN), auto-scan, internal reference and power down
device.note: tlv1570.pdf (SLAS169B) p.1 pinout (DW/PW), p.2 terminal functions, p.4 sampling (16 SCLKs per cycle), power down and configuration cycle timing (Figure 2), p.5 configuration register (CR) definition, p.6-7 initialization examples, p.8 DSP / uC interface (FS sampled at CS fall), p.11 recommended operating conditions, p.15 timing requirements (t(s) 6 SCLKs, t(conv) 10 SCLKs, td(3) 20 ns), p.16 Figures 7-8 (SDIN on SCLK falling, SDOUT on SCLK rising)

registers.name: CR
registers.note: p.5 configuration register DI15..DI0 (internal, written by every 16-bit SDIN frame; reset/default values not given, 0 here). DI9..DI7 select the channel with auto-scan off; with DI10 = 1, DI9..DI8 pick the scan sequence and DI7 resets it

commands.name: Configure, read register
commands.note: p.5 DI14 = 1: reads out the internal register (DI15..DI1 only). The datasheet does not give the read-out frame; modeled as DI15..DI1 MSB first in the next frame, then 0

commands.name: Configure
commands.note: p.4-5: 16 bits DI15..DI0 MSB first on SDIN, latched on SCLK falling edges; the configuration takes effect in the next cycle

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (terminal functions), p.4 (16-SCLK cycle, power down, Figure 2), p.5 (CR definition), p.6-7 (examples), p.8 (uC/DSP interface), p.11 (ROC: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-5.5 V, SCLK 20/10 MHz), p.15 (timing: t(s), t(conv), td(3) 20 ns), p.16 (Figures 7-8)
notModeled: analog inputs, MUX output MO / ADC input AIN loop, internal / external reference (CR.REFSEL, CR.REFV) and self-test inputs (CR.TEST, AGND or VREF/2): stored only; every conversion returns the 0 V code 0x000

SDOUT frame: the datasheet shows zeros during the 6-SCLK sampling period and the result shifted out during the 10-SCLK conversion (p.4 Figure 2, p.16); modeled as 0{6} R{10}. The result comes from the configuration written in the previous cycle (one-cycle pipeline); with a constant 0 V code this is not visible
register read-back (CR.DI14 = 1): the datasheet says only DI15-DI1 are read out (p.5) but gives no frame layout or timing; the model shifts DI15..DI1 then 0 in the next frame instead of the result
channel auto-scan (CR.DI10 = 1, sequences selected by DI9-DI8, reset by DI7, p.5-7): stored only; [CH] is the CR.CH field as written
DSP mode (FS low at CS falling, frame starts at the FS pulse, p.8, Figure 7): only uC mode with FS tied high is modeled
software power down (CR.DI15, effective one cycle later, 800 ns resume) and auto power down (CR.DI4): stored only; no effect on the bus (p.4)
the conversion is clocked by SCLK (10 SCLKs, p.15) and is not timed; SCLK up to 20 MHz (DVDD 4.5-5.5 V) or 10 MHz (2.7-3.6 V) (p.11)
CS-fall to first SDOUT bit and CS-rise to Hi-Z times are not specified (timing tValid / tFloat 0); SDOUT is 3-state while CS is high (p.8)
variants: Single device on this datasheet (C and I grades).
